description:
Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.

Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex, real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? 

The Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program at Picnic is a two-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.

At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket.
We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

From learning to leading

Throughout the two-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.

You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.

As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, the pace is yours to set, and there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.

Where you’ll make an impact

From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:

  • Consumer - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.
  • Tech - Work at the intersection of product and infrastructure, building scalable systems that power our operations. Think: building software and algorithms our FCAs run on or launch new features in our app used by millions.   
  • Logistics - Build the backbone of Picnic: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more

Your superpowers

You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.

More specifically, you:

  • Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative field: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar
  • Have experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar.
  • Show an entrepreneurial mindset: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked
  • Think like a builder: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions
  • You have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages 

Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.

 Why Picnic?

  • Grow as we grow. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours.
  • Work with other innovators. Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)
  • Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic.

When are you joining? 

  • Fall Edition 2026
    Start dates: September, October
    *earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question
  • Spring Edition 2027
    Start dates: February, March
    *earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question

📍 Location: Full-time in Amsterdam, with periodic trips to DE or FR

There is no deadline: Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride. 

Picnic Perks

🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks
Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

🚲Health insurance discount & bike plan
We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate

🗺️Relocation
If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs for you and your partner and kids, your first month's rent and moving costs (up to €2000), and help you with the 30% tax ruling setup and application. 

🍎Learning & development
You’ll get ample opportunity to work on yourself at Picnic. We offer personal development through Lepaya courses, Academy trainings, and more. Interested in improving your mental wellbeing? Through OpenUp you get free access to trained psychologists and many courses. 

⛳All the rest
At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well.

FAQ

Do I need a quantitative background? It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.

Does the program include rotations? No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.

In what language should I apply? English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)

What are the long-term opportunities after the program? This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. 

Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.

3743 - Associate Director, Data Engineering, UK

Role Summary and Impact

DTA is WPP’s global data products and technology arm. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.

We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising.

We’re endlessly curious. Our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

About WPP Media BI & Data Management

As the central hub for BI and data engineering, our team of 30+ specialists is responsible for the integrity, flow, and accessibility of data across the entire WPP Media ecosystem. By bridging technical data engineering with advanced BI reporting, we provide the robust foundation that powers WPP Media’s platform and drives growth at scale.

As Associate Director, Engineering you will be joining the BI & Data Management division of WPP Media’s Data, Technology and Analytics team.

This role involves leading client projects and overseeing the strategic development of solutions that aggregate diverse data sources into a single, unified view. You will act as a subject matter expert and strategic for our Measure data platform – a unified system for data connection, ingestion, transformation, and reporting – built on a robust technology stack including Adverity, GCP, and PowerBI. 

You will be responsible for the strategic design and delivery of robust, scalable data engineering solutions that power critical insights and analytics for our diverse client base.

You will be responsible for establishing best practices, quality assurance processes and ways of working that ensure the reporting solutions we deliver are consistently accurate and meeting the needs of our clients. Your core focus will be on partnering with our clients to deeply understand their strategic objectives and challenges. You will also be responsible for fostering a high-performing and collaborative team culture between your direct report, the WPP 650 BI team, and the wider business.  


 Key Responsibilities

  • In partnership with others in the BI & DM team, design, build, and implement robust data engineering solutions and data pipelines, high standards for data quality, reliability, and performance.
  • Serve as senior technical liaison and strategic partner to planning teams, client stakeholders, and cross-functional departments, translating business specifications into precise technical requirements for implementation. 
  • Design and enforce robust validation and auditing processes to ensure the highest levels of data integrity, consistency, and reliability across all platforms. 
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of data pipelines and data models to power dashboarding solutions delivered via the Measure platform, taking ownership of advanced data model design, dashboard deployment strategies, innovation, and change management.  
  • Lead initiatives to identify, evaluate, and integrate new data sources and technologies to enhance the Measure platform's capabilities and drive continuous improvement. 
  • Mentor and guide your direct reports on BI best practices, advanced data modeling, Power BI development, data governance, and effective client engagement. 

 

Skills and Experience

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

Essential

  • Experience in designing, architecting, and implementing complex data integration strategies, transforming disparate datasets into unified, high-value data models for advanced analytics and visualization. 
  • Extensive experience with cloud data platforms, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services.
  • High proficiency in SQL for data manipulation, transformation, and analysis, with an emphasis on optimization and best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing, building, and maintaining complex and scalable data pipelines (ETL/ELT).
  • Experience with data transformation tools like dbt.
  • Experience working with data ingestion tools like Adverity.
  • Deep understanding and practical application of data modeling techniques.
  • Extensive experience working with digital marketing, media campaign data, ad serving technologies, and/or web analytics data, with the ability to guide a team in this domain.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking, project management, and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on delivering impactful, high-quality solutions.

Desirable:

  • Experience working with dashboarding tools (PowerBi preferred)
  • Proficiency in a scripting language like Python.
  • Exposure to CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
  • Experience with project management tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Basic understanding of data governance principles.

 

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. What’s it like to manage the commercial engine of Europe’s fastest-growing online supermarket? At Picnic, we don't just buy products - we redefine how food reaches millions of homes by building smarter assortments, negotiating hard with global brands, and launching our own Private Label lines. 🥑🥐🍎

  • Supplier Negotiation: Prepare and lead negotiations that secure the best terms. From initial outreach to signed contracts, you'll own the process end-to-end

  • Margin & Price Execution: Continuously monitor cost changes, inflation impacts, and competitor pricing to protect margins while keeping Picnic unbeatable on price.
  • Cross-Functional Rigor: Partner with supply chain, design, and analytics teams to align commercial goals with operational excellence.


Your superpowers

We set a high bar. We look for top-tier candidates who combine sharp quantitative thinking with a natural commercial drive and zero hesitation to pick up the phone and negotiate.

  • Choose Category Management if you are driven by products, supplier negotiations, unit economics, and food trends.

We help organisations turn data and AI into measurable business impact across the value chain, from strategy and operating model to data platforms, AI products and marketing. More than 2,500 consultants, data scientists and engineers work for over 1,000 clients worldwide, including Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi.

In Switzerland, our team of around 50 people works from Zurich and Lausanne with Swiss and international companies. Our work covers AI strategy and governance, data transformation and AI use cases that run in production.

What you will be doing: Key responsibilities

We are looking for a Partner to scale Artefact’s Pharma & Life Sciences practice in Switzerland. Many global pharma, biotech and medtech companies run their headquarters, R&D, manufacturing or commercial functions from Switzerland. We already work with life sciences clients here and now want to make this practice one of the pillars of our Swiss business. This is an origination role: most of your time goes into winning new clients and expanding existing relationships. You will be based in Zurich and work with clients across Basel, Zurich and Romandie.

Your role will encompass:

  • Scaling the Swiss Life Sciences practice: its offer, its client base and its team, in coordination with Artefact’s global healthcare and life sciences teams.
  • Growing existing client relationships and winning new clients, so that the practice moves from first references to a broad portfolio.
  • Leading senior client stakeholders (CDO/CDAO, CIO, heads of Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs, R&D Operations, Manufacturing & Quality) through data and AI transformation.
  • Overseeing project delivery and quality assurance on our life sciences engagements, and giving strategic support to ongoing client programmes.
  • Sparring with the Swiss Managing Partner on practice strategy and investment.

Among your responsibilities as Partner, you will:

Build the practice and its offer

  • Build on our existing life sciences work to define where data and AI create value along the pharma value chain: R&D and clinical development, regulatory and medical affairs, manufacturing and quality, supply chain, and commercial engagement.
  • Translate this into a few Swiss offers with clear entry points, scope and pricing.

Develop the client portfolio

  • Build a go-to-market plan for Swiss life sciences, own the pipeline and write proposals that address the client’s actual problem.
  • Navigate pharma procurement: vendor qualification, framework agreements and preferred-supplier panels.

Deliver to the highest standard

  • Sponsor and oversee engagements run day to day by Engagement Managers, with multidisciplinary teams of consultants, data scientists and data/AI engineers, and ensure the quality of what we deliver.
  • Make sure delivery meets regulatory requirements: GxP, validation of AI systems, Swiss FADP/GDPR and the EU AI Act.
  • Be accountable for client satisfaction, project margin and team experience.

Develop our knowledge base

  • Speak and publish on AI in life sciences, for example GenAI in medical and regulatory writing, AI in clinical operations, HCP engagement, and AI governance under GxP.
  • Turn our Swiss life sciences work into references and case studies, and bring them into Artefact’s global practice.

Lead and develop the team

  • Hire and develop consultants with life sciences experience, train the wider Swiss team on the domain, and own staffing on your engagements.

What we are looking for

  • 12–15 years of experience, including 8+ years serving pharma, biotech or medtech clients at a life sciences–focused consultancy or the life sciences practice of a strategy or technology firm. A later move in-house is welcome.
  • Currently Director, Principal or Associate Partner with a personal sales target, ready for the step to Partner.
  • A track record of origination with life sciences clients: you can name clients you opened yourself and the revenue you sold, beyond extending existing accounts.
  • A network among decision-makers in the Swiss life sciences industry, especially in Basel and Zurich, that you are actively growing.
  • Working knowledge of GxP and computer system validation, and how they apply to data and AI systems.
  • Working fluency in data and AI: you can discuss what an AI use case needs from data, what it costs and when it pays back.
  • Fluent English. German is a strong advantage, French a plus.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to the Zurich area, with regular travel to Basel.

Why you should join us

  • Shape what comes next: the Swiss practice has proven itself and is growing fast. It is still small enough that you shape its clients, its offers and its team.
  • Sell with a global platform: you bring the credentials, delivery capacity and AI assets of a 2,500-person firm into every proposal, and you work with industry leads across Europe.
  • Strategy to production under one roof: our consultants and engineers work in the same teams, so your clients get from recommendation to working solution without changing firms.
  • Culture: innovation, collaboration and action shape how we work. Artefact Switzerland is Great Place to Work certified (2026).
  • Entrepreneurship: you are measured on the clients, revenue and team you build.

description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating or licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured content into the AlphaSense platform. The team reports to the Chief Content Officer and has strategy, product and content management, collection operations and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing rapid growth across all content sets. We value and uphold transparency, trust, and accountability in our relationships within the Content teams and with external partners and internal stakeholders.

About the Role: 

We are seeking a Product Manager for New Content Evaluation and Analysis to help us expand and strengthen the breadth, quality, and value of the data and content that power our Platform. Candidates should have deep knowledge of capital markets and investment research combined with extensive experience of evaluating and integrating financial research content and AI-powered investment analysis workflows.

Major Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Identify the Need and Showcase the Value:  Help identify and evaluate third-party quantitative and qualitative datasets and content for the needs of the AlphaSense platform (e.g. market data, fundamentals, estimates, ESG, news, research, transcripts, regulatory filings, and alternative data). Work alongside Partnership Management and Content Leads to assess data quality, methodology, licensing terms, and integration feasibility.
  • Lead the Due Diligence Effort: Run point on active vendor evaluations, including data trials, support proofs of concept, and own the framework to evaluate coverage, timeliness, accuracy, and history analysis. Help build content org-wide business case for new datasets and quantify value proposition, cost, buy vs build impact, and strategic fit
  • Become a Use Case Expert for AlphaSense content. Contribute to market research and competitive analysis to identify net new opportunities for innovation and differentiation. Identify new high impact AI-driven functionality and data sets and formulate the licensing target vendor or self-sourcing strategy to introduce new content into the AlphaSense platform and agentic workflows.
  • Market Research and Assessment: Track industry trends and competing platforms, solutions, and content to deliver competitive intelligence and better evolve product and content vision. Keep abreast of a rapidly evolving competitive landscape and client expectations along with unprecedented LLM and AI workflow advances. 

Who You Are:

  • You have genuine excitement and passion for corporate finance, capital markets, and investment research coupled with data management expertise demonstrated either in previous capacity at a buy-side or sell-side firm or you have successfully supported AI products/features/data used by investment and data analysis professionals
  • You have natural enthusiasm for working at the intersection of AI, data, technology, and investment research and track record of expert-level data analysis at scale using traditional data query or generative AI tools and platforms
  • You have the energy and enthusiasm to work in a high-paced, high-growth environment and you are comfortable accommodating rapidly changing business priorities
  • You have excellent presentation skills with demonstrated ability to inform and influence executives and align with multiple levels of stakeholders
  • You have driven successful due diligence project outcomes or run content evaluations with diverse businesses and teams across multiple locations 
  • You demonstrate empathic communication, with the ability to listen and identify problems in need of solutions

What We Are Looking For: 

  • A minimum of 5+ years of work experience at a leading financial institution or investment research platform firm focused on the delivery or evaluation of content, features, analytics, and models for front-office investment professionals
  • Expert knowledge of contemporary market data and investment research databases, products, and workflow tools (e.g.: Fundamentals, Estimates, Transactions data, Ownership data, Market data, News, Transcripts)
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a dedicated cross-functional product development or evaluation teams of engineers, content leads, and vendor management professionals
  • Thorough understanding of the logic and concepts of relational and JSON databases. Demonstrated experience of running complex data queries and analyses using traditional data- query or contemporary generative AI techniques is a must
  • Demonstrated ability to set priorities, stay focused, and meet or beat deadlines
  • BSc degree or material academic background in a quantitative analysis field 

PREFERRED

  • Experience in content acquisition and licensing
  • Prior experience at a market intelligence or financial research SaaS start-up
  • Exposure to iterative / agile development methodologies in the context of product development
  • Experience working with distributed teams

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

  • Excellent business analysis and financial modeling skills, with experience building business cases and measuring the impact of new initiatives.
  • Familiarity with emerging technologies like AI/automation and a deep understanding of how they can be applied to drive business value.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Missions and activities of the position

1. Project phase – owner's engineer for Maintenance

  • Represent Maintenance in every phase of new equipment projects (starting with the MRS1 cross-belt sorter), from design reviews to FAT, SAT, commissioning and ramp-up. For the sorter, whose design is already set, take over the installed system and optimise it after go-live.
  • Work side by side with the OEM / integrator engineers: collect technical knowledge, challenge design choices, maintainability, access, spare-part strategy and the proposed maintenance plan before they are frozen.
  • Define and verify the Maintenance acceptance criteria (documentation, training, spare parts, safety, availability targets). The Maintenance sign-off is mandatory: no handover to operations without it.
  • Track and drive to closure the technical punch list and warranty issues raised during commissioning and the warranty period.

2. Technical file & spare parts

  • Build and own the equipment technical file: as-built electrical and mechanical drawings, PLC and software versions, parameter backups, network architecture, safety documentation, OEM manuals.
  • Create the asset hierarchy and criticality analysis in the CMMS.
  • Define the critical spare-parts list (references, min/max stock, lead times) and keep it up to date.
  • Reduce dependency on the OEM: identify and qualify second-source suppliers for critical parts, run compatibility tests and document equivalences.
  • Propose spare-parts and supplier decisions to the Maintenance Manager; after an initial period, take these decisions autonomously within agreed limits, with the Maintenance Manager's validation.

3. Maintenance strategy & procedures

  • Write and maintain preventive maintenance plans, corrective procedures and troubleshooting guides for the equipment family, based on OEM data, FMEA and field experience.
  • Monitor equipment performance (availability, MTBF, MTTR, top failure modes), lead root-cause analysis on recurring or major failures and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Challenge the original design when needed and drive engineering changes: retrofits, drive and firmware updates, software or parameter optimisation, with the OEM and internal stakeholders.

4. Training & technical support

  • Train the operational maintenance team (technicians and operatives) on the equipment, its software/HMI and the troubleshooting procedures; validate their autonomy level.
  • Act as the level-2 / level-3 technical expert for the equipment family on site and remotely, across sites.

5. Escalation, vendor & SLA management

  • Own technical escalations through to resolution: with the Tetris team (Vinted's internal tools and sorting logic) when the issue is on the software or data side, and with OEM / integrator support (SAV) when it is on the equipment side.
  • Lead the diagnosis that tells which side an issue comes from (equipment, controls, Vinted software), with facts and data.
  • Work within the after-sales and maintenance agreements already in place with OEMs: make the most of them day to day, monitor performance against SLAs and warranty terms, feed lessons learned into future renewals, and provide the technical evidence to the program managers, who own the contractual relationship.
  • Prepare and lead technical review meetings with OEMs and integrators.

6. Safety & compliance

  • Ensure the equipment and its maintenance comply with machine safety requirements (CE marking, safety functions, lock-out/tag-out) and site H&S standards.
  • Support safety audits and regulatory inspections, and drive the resulting corrective actions to completion.

Occasional responsibilities

  • Take ownership of additional equipment families (e.g. conveyors, AMR fleets, Monk lines) once the cross-belt is stable.
  • Support pre-project technical due diligence on new equipment (specifications, vendor benchmarks, maintainability review).
  • Participate in the hiring and onboarding of maintenance technicians and future engineers.

Interests, constraints, difficulties of the position

  • High-visibility role on new strategic automation investments.
  • Site-based in an operational warehouse, with regular presence on the shop floor.
  • Regular travel to MRS1, OEM premises (FAT) and other Vinted Go sites, especially during commissioning.
  • Day-based role, no on-call. Flexibility needed during commissioning, ramp-up and major incidents (possible early, late or weekend work).
  • Needs to influence without authority: OEMs, integrators, IT and program management teams.

 

Your profile

Knowledge & experience

  • Engineering degree (Master's / Bac+5) in automation, electrical, mechatronics or industrial engineering, or Bac+2/3 with equivalent proven experience.
  • At least 3 years' experience, ideally 5 or more, as Equipment Engineer, Automation Engineer, Tool Owner or Maintenance/Reliability Engineer in a highly automated environment: parcel sortation and intralogistics, airport baggage handling, logistics or other automated industries.
  • Automation background required.
  • Proven involvement in at least one industrial equipment project from FAT/SAT to ramp-up, working with OEMs or integrators.

Technical skills

  • Able to read and diagnose complete PLC and HMI programs (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell, Beckhoff) and to make controlled modifications; industrial networks (Profinet, Profibus, EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP).
  • Drives (parameters, firmware), servo motors, sensors, scanners / DWS, pneumatics; reading electrical and mechanical schematics.
  • Retrofit experience and component qualification (equivalence, compatibility testing)
  • Safety PLCs and machine safety functions.
  • Understanding of the interfaces between equipment controls, SCADA/WCS and IT systems.
  • Reliability methods: FMEA, RCA (5 Why, Ishikawa, 8D), criticality analysis; CMMS and PM planning.
  • Sortation equipment experience (cross-belt, tilt-tray, shoe sorters) is a strong plus.
  • French electrical certification (habilitation électrique BR / B2V / BC) or ability to obtain it.
  • Fluent French and professional English (OEMs and the Vinted Go network work in English).

Behavioural skills

  • Strong ownership: treats the equipment as their own, from design to end of life.
  • Able to challenge OEM and integrator engineers constructively, with facts and data.
  • Structured and disciplined in documentation.
  • Good teacher: enjoys transferring knowledge to technicians.
  • Calm and solution-oriented under production pressure; strong safety mindset.

Working at Vinted 

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in London — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.

This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.

You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.

The Pod Model

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. 

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

What You'll Do

• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for English-language use cases and UK/Irish-specific regulatory environments (UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, EU AI Act for cross-border workloads)
• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from the UK and Ireland
• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

What We're Looking For

• CS degree or equivalent experience
• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency
• Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts
• Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems
• Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own
• Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week
• Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause
• Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.
• Based in London, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across the UK and Ireland
• Legally authorized to work in the UK, or eligible for sponsorship

Bonus Points For

• Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems
• Building eval sets for a specific domain
• Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management
• Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models
• Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)
• SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)
• ETL and data wrangling experience
• CI/CD pipeline design and automation
• Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS
• Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and UK/Irish regulatory frameworks (UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, EU AI Act for cross-border workloads, NIS Regulations, FCA operational resilience requirements for financial services customers)
• Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)

You will own our early customer implementations and help the founding team shape the product around what actually works.

Working directly with customers, you'll figure out their GTM operations, identify where agentic automations can help, and build solutions around those needs. Alongside the product and technical founders, you’ll use what you learn from these implementations to shape GrowthBricks itself.

Day to day, you will:

  • Work directly with customers to understand their GTM workflows, systems, data, and bottlenecks.
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into working GTM systems.
  • Help build signal pipelines, account intelligence systems, enrichment and qualification workflows, outbound and CRM automation, and agentic workflows using GrowthBricks.

  • Clear communication across roles. You can work effectively with founders, sales and marketing teams, RevOps specialists, and engineers.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can take an unclear business problem and work toward a concrete solution.

  • Experience implementing GTM systems across multiple teams or customers.

In your first six months, you will have taken several customer problems from discovery to working production workflows.

You will also have helped us understand where GrowthBricks creates the most value, identified patterns that repeat across customers, and turned those patterns into reusable product capabilities.

Success means building systems that customers actually use, producing measurable GTM outcomes, and making the product materially better with every implementation.

At Jensen Hughes, we’ve been helping make our world safe, secure and resilient since 1939. Today, our global network of experts works across fire protection engineering, security and risk-based fields, including
accessibility consulting, risk analysis, process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management and digital innovation.

Our Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organisation, supporting career development and creating opportunities to share experiences, build connections and learn from one another.

Job Overview

Ready to start a career where your engineering skills can make a real difference?

We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Fire Engineer to join Jensen Hughes across the UK and Ireland and become part of our 2,000+ global employees working together to advance the science of safety every day.

These roles are open across our UK & Ireland offices. Please apply only to your preferred location. If you are open to more than one location, we will discuss this with you during the recruitment process.

Please note: to be considered for this role, you must have the right to work in the UK or Ireland.

Why join Jensen Hughes and grow your career?

Your career can go further than you think. 74% of our current Directors and Technical Directors in the UK & Ireland started their careers with us as graduates.

Be part of a leading fire consultancy. We have offices across Belgium, Finland, Italy, Denmark and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.

Learn from experienced engineers. As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic design team. Working alongside experienced Engineers, you will receive ongoing technical support to build your knowledge and experience across fire engineering projects.

Build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team where we strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

Take responsibility early. You will be given early responsibility and the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to work towards chartered status through the Institute of Fire Engineers, providing help and support throughout the process.

What will you be working on?

As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you’ll work on a variety of exciting projects, helping to develop innovative fire engineering solutions for new and existing buildings.

Your work will include:

  • Carrying out fire engineering analysis on a
    range of new and existing building projects.
  • Working across a diverse range of buildings,
    including high-rise office buildings, large retail complexes and airport
    developments, each presenting its own unique challenges.
  • Analysing fire growth, means of escape,
    structural fire resistance and smoke control using a variety of methods,
    including computer modelling software such as Computational Fluid Dynamics.
  • Preparing technical reports and liaising with
    clients, including some of the largest building developers in the country.

Requirements and Qualifications

To set you up for success in the role, you’ll need:

  • Right to work in the UK or Ireland.
  • A Master’s degree, achieved within the last two
    years or expected, in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering,
    Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Physics.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication
    skills in English.
  • Additional qualifications and experience

The following would also help you succeed in the role:

  • A team player who can work effectively with
    colleagues at all levels.
  • Excellent communication and time management
    skills.
  • Enthusiasm to innovate.
  • A second European language is an advantage but
    not essential.

We’ve successfully welcomed Graduate Fire Engineers from a variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us.

If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Fire Engineering and have a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us why you’re ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.

Graduate Development Programme

Starting your career is about more than your first role, it’s about building the foundations for your future.

Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands-on project experience, mentorship and support as you work towards professional accreditation. Over two years, you’ll gain experience across fire engineering and related disciplines, helping you build the knowledge and skills needed for a successful and impactful career.

You’ll also have the opportunity to undertake Continuing Professional Development (CPD) as you progress through the programme, helping you continue to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. We provide support and encouragement for Engineers working towards Chartered Engineer status, helping you work towards this important professional milestone as you build your career with Jensen Hughes.

Sustainability in Fire Engineering

At Jensen Hughes, fire safety and sustainability go hand in hand.

In the UK, we support the design of safe, energy-efficient and sustainable buildings that meet BREEAM standards and align with net-zero goals. As a graduate, you’ll play a role in delivering solutions that protect people while helping to create a more sustainable built environment.

Our People Are Our Greatest Asset

At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. To attract and retain the best talent, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance, and professional growth.

Our UK&I Benefits Include:

  • Private medical insurance
  • 33 days of holiday(including
    bank holidays) with an additional day after 3 years
  • Industry-leading contributory pension scheme
  • 4x life assurance
  • Income protection scheme
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Enhanced parental-related pay
  • Recognition and reward programmers to celebrate
    team efforts
  • Access to extensive technical training and
    resources

Supporting Your Work-Life Balance:

We understand the importance of flexibility and balance. We're happy to discuss hybrid, part-time, and flexible working arrangements to suit both you and the business. For certain teams, this may include an early Friday finish at 3 pm once contracted hours and client deadlines are met. We also offer:

  • Flexible working hours and patterns
  • Flexible holiday use over Christmas/New Year
  • Enhanced holiday entitlement after three years
  • The option to carry over up to five unused
    holiday days into the next year (subject to discussion and approval)

A Commitment to Continuous Improvement

Our benefits represent a meaningful investment in both our people and the future of Jensen Hughes. We regularly review our benefits programme to ensure it aligns with statutory requirements, market trends, and the needs of our team. Any modifications will be carefully considered to support our employees and the company’s long-term goals.

The Role

To provide technical leadership and hands-on contribution within a data engineering team, designing, building, and optimizing robust data pipelines and infrastructure for a global sports betting and media business. This role is crucial in delivering high-quality data solutions that support LiveScore’s strategic goals and embody our commitment to being Fan Driven and a Champion of Sport. You will mentor junior engineers and ensure technical excellence in your domain.

At LiveScore Group, we’re the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We’re proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan’s passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don’t just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it’s our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you’re good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.

We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you’re passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you! 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Technical Leadership and Guidance: Act as a primary technical point of contact and subject matter expert for specific data engineering projects or domains, guiding team members through complex technical challenges and promoting innovative solutions.
  • End-to-End Data Solution Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy highly scalable, reliable, and fault-tolerant data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes. This includes data ingestion from diverse sources, data transformation, and data loading into various data stores (e.g., data warehouses, data lakes).
  • Architectural Implementation: Work closely with Data Architects to translate architectural blueprints and standards into concrete implementations, ensuring new data components align with the overall data strategy and infrastructure requirements.
  • Mentorship and Skill Development: Actively mentor and coach junior and mid-level data engineers, providing constructive feedback, sharing technical knowledge, and fostering their growth in coding, data modeling, and general data engineering best practices.
  • Hands-On Contribution: Maintain a significant hands-on role in coding, data modeling, infrastructure-as-code development, and platform configuration, leading by example and ensuring high-quality output.
  • Data Quality and Performance Assurance: Take direct responsibility for ensuring the quality, integrity, and performance of data assets within their assigned domain or projects, implementing monitoring, validation, and optimization strategies.
  • Operational Efficiency and Cost Optimization: Proactively identify and implement technical optimizations for data processing, storage, and infrastructure utilization to improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and enhance system performance.
  • Code Review and Best Practices: Lead and participate in rigorous code reviews, advocating for and enforcing engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural patterns to maintain high code quality and system stability.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and provide effective solutions for highly complex data-related issues, incidents, and performance bottlenecks, often working under pressure.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with other engineering teams, product managers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements, integrate solutions, and provide technical insights.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Advanced Data Pipeline Expertise: Proven, in-depth experience as a senior or lead data engineer with a strong portfolio of hands-on contributions to designing, building, and optimizing complex, large-scale data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Enterprise Data Warehousing (EDW) and Data Modeling: Strong practical experience with EDW concepts, principles, and implementation, specifically including the design and practical application of a single, integrated data model for analytical purposes.
  • Cloud Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with cloud-native data services and infrastructure on at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS services like S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR; GCP services like BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub; Azure services like Data Lake, Synapse Analytics).
  • Cost Optimization Strategies: Demonstrated ability to identify, propose, and implement technical solutions that lead to significant cost savings in data processing, storage, and infrastructure within a large-scale data environment.
  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: Expert proficiency in software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum), version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and comprehensive understanding of software engineering best practices.
  • Programming Languages: Exceptional coding skills in at least one relevant programming language (e.g., Python, Scala, Java, JavaScript, C/C++), with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
  • Database Systems: Extensive experience with various database technologies including relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra), and analytical data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery).
  • Data Architecture Principles: Solid understanding of data architecture patterns (e.g., Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, Lambda/Kappa architectures), distributed systems, and their practical application.
  • Regulatory Reporting: Practical experience in developing and maintaining robust and auditable data solutions for regulatory reporting, particularly within the gaming or other highly regulated industries.
  • AI: Fluent in AI prompting alongside staying ahead of emerging AI technologies.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: A natural leader who can effectively guide, inspire, and technically mentor junior and mid-level engineers. Possesses the ability to break down complex problems, provide clear direction, and foster a learning environment, thereby enhancing team capabilities and promoting adherence to best practices.

What can we offer?

  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan
  • Virgin Family: Giving you access to exclusive Virgin offers and experiences
  • Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. You will lead innovation on some of the most complex, ambiguous, and large-scale solutions, aligning them with target architecture standards and contributing to the creation of a scalable platform.

You’ll have a broad sphere of influence, enabling multiple teams and serving as a strategic partner to our architecture leadership team and our community of principal and staff engineers.

Your impact will come mostly from 'hands-off' work; you’ll not be expected to write code day-to-day. But for some challenges, you may need to dive into code-level design or help build a proof-of-concept.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.
  • Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.
  • Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validation of advanced avionics PCBs and modular systems.
  • Specify and document additional manufacturer tests (like flying probe) to allow for a layered, holistic approach to test coverage.
  • Write Repair Guides that document the error cases and the affected components.
  • Guide manufacturers with new product integrations usually in person in the factory.
  • Manage tracking systems across multiple locations to inspect the product workflow.
  • Support internal CI systems with real hardware to validate test procedures before upgrading test fixtures at OEMs.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • Proficiency in modern Python and C/C++ also applied to embedded systems.
  • 5+ years of experience in programming software that runs on real hardware and testing it on real hardware.
  • CAD experience (e.g., Onshape) and soldering skills are required.
  • Practical experience in Linux, microcontroller programming, 3D printing, and related prototyping tools.
  • Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Good verbal and written English communication skills.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software and electronics platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

Your mission Robotic Sales Engineers (RSEs) are RobCo’s technical face to the customer. As Manager Robotic Sales Engineering, you lead a team of around six RSEs and report to the Head of Robotic Sales Engineering. You make sure every deal gets the right technical lead, every customer gets a consistent experience and every RSE on your team keeps getting better. You carry a quota together with Sales and are measured on whether your team hits it. You are a player-coach. You lead the team, and you still go on-site for the deals that matter most. You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help scale how RobCo brings physical AI into real production. What you will do Lead and grow the team – Hire, onboard and coach your RSEs. Run regular 1:1s, give clear feedback, write performance reviews and build real career paths. Deliver the quota – Own your team’s quota together with your Sales counterparts. Track pipeline and win rates, spot deals at risk early and put your team’s capacity where it moves the number. Steer the deal portfolio – Match RSEs to Account Executives and deals, balance workload and set priorities together with Sales and Delivery, so no customer waits and no deal slips. Raise the quality bar – Set the standard for discovery, requirement workshops, feasibility checks and handovers. Review the critical concepts before they go to the customer or to Solutions Development. Be hands-on where it counts – Join strategic accounts and complex workshops yourself, and be the technical escalation point for customers and AEs. Own the interfaces – Work closely with Sales leadership, Solutions Development and Product to keep handovers clean and expectations aligned. Improve how we work – Shape the team’s processes, templates, tools and KPIs, and turn field insights into input for Product. What you bring 5+ years in technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects, including 2+ years leading a team You’ve run requirement workshops, won deals yourself and worked against a quota, so you know what it takes to hit it You still enjoy being in front of customers and are credible with an engineer on the shop floor and a plant manager deciding on the investment You make people better: you coach, give direct feedback and know when to step in and when to let your team own it You set clear priorities when everything feels urgent, and you can explain them to sales, engineering and management alike You build structure that helps the team move faster, not process for its own sake You speak German and English fluently You are happy to travel, around 30% of the time Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus Experience building or scaling a team in a fast-growing company is a plus A background at a robot manufacturer or system integrator is a plus Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. description: About The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there. You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls. AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results. Your Mission Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured. 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration. Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build. Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work. Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated. AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it. Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest. Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense. Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously. Your Profile 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users. AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products. Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture. Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments. Strong grasp of UX. description: TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national. Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Métrologie et maîtrise de la température • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise. • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.). • Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements. • Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives. • Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC. Étude et déploiement des matériels • Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise. • Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée. • Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués. • Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels. • Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils. Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels). • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées. • Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées. Gestion des fournisseurs • Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques. • Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations. • Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires. • Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée. Qualité et amélioration continue • Participer aux audits internes et externes. • Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail. • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance. • Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité. • Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue. • Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température). ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : • proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ; • valider les choix techniques des installations ; • décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ; • arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ; • sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation. • Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations. RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES En interne • Direction des Opérations • Responsable Parc Automobile • Responsable Exploitation • Service Qualité • Conducteurs • Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température). En externe • Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques • Prestataires de métrologie • Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques. PROFIL RECHERCHE Formation • Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent. Expérience • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire. • Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.
