description: Product Marketing Lead In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. As our Product Marketing Lead, you will own how we show up for health system leaders. That covers the sales content that moves deals forward, the messaging behind each new module, and the story we tell customers who are ready to grow with us. Who We Are Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our peer-reviewed research in Nature Medicine associating our products with improved patient outcomes. About the Role This role spans three connected areas of product marketing: sales enablement, module marketing, and customer expansion. You will own all three end to end. Most of your energy will go to enablement, expansion, and module marketing, in that order of urgency as the field and our roadmap demand. Product marketing is a function we are still building. You will be our dedicated product marketer, so you will set the standards, templates, and systems as much as you follow them. You will decide what gets built next based on what Sales and Client Success tell you is moving deals and renewals. As the team grows, you may have the chance to mentor more junior marketers. What You'll Own Sales Enablement Own the core sales content library, including the sales deck, two-pagers, white papers, and collateral that quantify our impact for buyers and customers. Keep it accurate and current as the product and the market change. Work with Sales to learn which pieces move deals forward and which ones don't. Deal-Specific Content Build tailored content for late-stage opportunities, such as custom one-pagers and slides. Take a rough brief from a sales rep and return a polished deliverable without a heavy process around you. Be able to point to specific content you built that helped advance or close a deal. Competitive Intelligence Maintain competitive intel and battlecards as the market shifts. Keep them current without being asked, so reps never walk into a conversation with outdated information. Product and Module Marketing Develop positioning and messaging by module and buyer. Build module deep-dive materials and lead go-to-market for module launches, including palliative care and deterioration. Customer Expansion Partner with Client Success on expansion messaging, executive steering committee and QBR materials, and release communications for existing customers. Help customers see the value they are already getting and what more is possible. Buyer Messaging Write for the full health system buying committee, including CMOs, CMIOs, CIOs, CFOs, and quality leaders. Translate clinical outcomes and technical capabilities into language that resonates with clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders. Make a business case land with a C-suite, not just a product pitch. Cross-Functional Partnership Join deal calls and QBRs. Pull roadmap details from Product proactively, and work with Clinical to keep every claim credible. Surface what is working in the field and feed market and competitive insight back into the business. What You'll Bring 5+ years of product marketing experience in healthcare technology, with direct experience marketing to health system executive buyers A bachelor's degree A record of building positioning, messaging, enablement, and launch programs that sales teams actually use A track record of deal-specific content tied to advanced or closed opportunities Experience writing for CMOs, CMIOs, CIOs, CFOs, and quality leaders, and supporting long, multi-stakeholder deals into health systems Working knowledge of how enterprise health system deals move, including committee-based buying, clinical validation, IT and security review, and budget cycles Exceptional writing that is clear, credible, and evidence-based, with first drafts that need little rework Self-direction in a fast-moving startup, including the instinct to spot what is missing and build it without being asked Strong partnership habits with Sales, Product, Client Success, and Clinical teams Nice to Haves Product or customer marketing experience with an installed base, including expansion or upsell campaigns Familiarity with clinical AI, clinical decision support, or quality and safety improvement Experience informally mentoring a more junior marketer Life at Bayesian We're a small, mission-driven team building AI tools that help clinicians catch life-threatening conditions earlier. We work remotely but stay closely connected in real time. We believe that closer collaboration helps us move faster for the hospitals and patients who depend on us. Our values guide how we work every day: Patients at the center. We hold ourselves to a high bar for excellence and impact. Hard problems, real breakthroughs. We pursue new ideas even when it's uncomfortable. No surprises, clear signals. We communicate clearly and honestly, so teams and customers can trust us. Whole people, shared respect. We treat teammates with respect and make space to grow. Truth seekers, stronger together. We debate openly and align around shared goals. What We Offer Medical, Dental & Vision: Coverage through Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, including an HSA-eligible option, plus dental and vision through Guardian/VSP. description: Clinical Quality Consultant In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You'll support product quality for an FDA-cleared, AI-driven clinical platform, from complaint investigation once it's live in hospitals, to the quality system and regulatory record that hold it all together. Who We Are Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our peer-reviewed research in Nature Medicine associating our products with improved patient outcomes. About the Role When a care team asks why an alert did or did not fire, that question comes to our Clinical Production Support team, and answering it well takes real clinical judgment. Clinical case reviews are the largest share of that work and the heart of this role. You will investigate what happened in a given encounter, reach a sound and defensible conclusion, and communicate it clearly to the clinicians and client teams who asked. Strong clinical reasoning is the foundation. On top of it, you will build a working understanding of how the product behaves, including how flags are generated, how suppression logic works, and how data moves from the EHR into the model. That technical fluency is taught here rather than expected at hire. The same is true of the medical device regulatory side, where you will grow into product complaint handling and, once trained, contribute to the disposition of possible anomalies that gate our releases. This is a function still being built. Case volume is growing faster than the process around it, so you will be writing and improving the review standards, templates, and escalation paths as much as you follow them. What You'll Own Clinical Case Review Perform clinical case reviews on sepsis alerts: work the encounter record, establish the clinical timeline, determine whether the alert behaved as designed, and produce an internal case review with cited evidence and a recommended next action. Product & Technical Fluency Build and apply working knowledge of how the product generates, suppresses, and delivers flags, including the EHR data that drives it, so your conclusions hold up to both clinical and technical scrutiny. Review the AI-assisted triage and classification our tooling performs, including investigation and complaint classification, ticket creation, and draft acknowledgements, and correct them where the clinical facts don't support the output. Communication & Escalation Write clear, accurate responses to the clinicians and clinical informatics teams who submitted the case, following our communication standards, which protect patient privacy and avoid giving clinical direction. Own escalation: route issues to the accountable team in data science, engineering, implementation, or clinical, give them the clinical context they need, and drive tickets through to closure rather than handing them off. Send close-out communications and close resolved tickets. Caseload Management Manage a concurrent caseload against response commitments: track status, prioritize by clinical and client risk, and keep the queue current without prompting. Pattern Recognition Look across cases, not only at them. Identify recurring patterns such as mapping failures, interface latency, or suppression gaps, quantify how often they occur, and raise them with the owning team before clients do. Process Ownership Create and improve case review templates, evidence standards, response language, triage rules, and escalation paths. Document what you build so the next reviewer reaches the same conclusion from the same facts. Complaint Handling Support product complaint handling: document complaints and assemble the clinical evidence a complaint review requires, and, once trained, contribute to the disposition of possible anomalies as part of the release process required of a regulated device. What You'll Bring Sound judgment and the ability to reason from vitals, labs, medications, and documentation to a defensible conclusion Clear written communication suited to clinician and clinical informatics audiences A record of getting things done without close supervision, in an environment where the process is still taking shape Evidence that you fix processes rather than work around them, something you found broken, changed, and documented so it stayed fixed The ability to learn a technical product quickly and reason about it accurately, including asking the right questions of engineering and data science Fluency with AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to verify their output rather than pass it through Comfort working in a ticket-driven, data-heavy environment, staying organized and accurate across many concurrent cases Genuine interest in learning medical device quality and regulatory practice, including complaint handling Qualifications 5 years of experience, either: An active RN license and 3+ years of acute care experience, for example ICU, emergency, or rapid response, with strong familiarity with sepsis and clinical deterioration OR Commensurate healthcare experience with ability to understand clinical aspects of sepsis and clinical deterioration Experience with EHRs such as Epic or Cerner, or work in clinical informatics, clinical research, or clinical decision support Exposure to SEP-1 or sepsis bundle abstraction and quality reporting Familiarity with medical device quality standards such as QMSR or ISO 13485, or clear eagerness to build that knowledge Comfort reading structured clinical data exports and spreadsheets Authorization to work in the United States Life at Bayesian We're a small, mission-driven team building AI tools that help clinicians catch life-threatening conditions earlier. We work remotely but stay closely connected in real time. We believe that closer collaboration helps us move faster for the hospitals and patients who depend on us. Our values guide how we work every day: Patients at the center. We hold ourselves to a high bar for excellence and impact. Hard problems, real breakthroughs. We pursue new ideas even when it's uncomfortable. No surprises, clear signals. We communicate clearly and honestly, so teams and customers can trust us. Whole people, shared respect. We treat teammates with respect and make space to grow. Truth seekers, stronger together. We debate openly and align around shared goals. description: Level: ES2-ES5 Hiring Manager: Recruiter: Celine Clark At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing. Enterprise Account Executive – Financial Services Why We Have This Role Our Enterprise Account Executive team is a group of highly driven individuals dedicated to closing experience gaps across the world’s leading financial institutions. In the modern Financial Services sector—spanning retail banking, wealth management, commercial banking, insurance, and fintech—digital transformation, client retention, regulatory compliance, omnichannel service, and advisor/employee experience are top priorities. Our SaaS platform empowers global financial institutions to capture real-time customer feedback, elevate digital and branch interactions, and drive action with pre-built Experience Management (XM) programs. How You’ll Find Success Takes Initiative: Understands the expected outcome, grasps complex financial service ecosystems, and works entrepreneurially to execute. Domain & Industry Acumen: Deep understanding of key business drivers, metrics, and buyer personas in Financial Services (e.g., Net Promoter Score/CSAT, customer churn prevention, digital adoption, wealth advisor retention, branch experience, and client lifetime value). Proven Deal Closer: Strong track record of consistently exceeding quota and acquiring high-value enterprise financial accounts. Complex Solution Selling: Ability to sell a multi-solution, enterprise-grade SaaS platform (Qualtrics Experience Management) into large, matrixed financial institutions with complex governance and security requirements. Strategic Negotiation: Skilled in navigating strict procurement procedures, vendor risk management (VRM) assessments, regulatory compliance evaluations, and enterprise contract negotiations. How You'll Grow Structured, 100% performance-based promotion pathway. Dedicated Career Action Planning alongside your leadership team. Internal mobility opportunities (Qmobility) across global teams and territories. Things You’ll Do Quarterback strategic enterprise deals with Fortune 500 banks, wealth management firms, insurance carriers, and fintech leaders in your territory. Consistently hit and exceed quarterly and annual revenue quotas. Cultivate C-level and VP-level relationships across Consumer Banking, Wealth & Asset Management, Digital Transformation, Customer Experience (CX), Operations, and Human Resources. Develop and maintain deep domain knowledge of Qualtrics’ XM offerings and how they solve financial services challenges (e.g., digital banking feedback loops, branch customer satisfaction, advisor onboarding/retention, insurance claims experience, and Voice of the Customer). Maintain a real-time understanding of the competitive landscape to build win-based proposals and strategic pricing models. Partner cross-functionally with internal teams (Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, SME Leads, and Customer Success) to orchestrate collaborative, high-impact enterprise sales cycles. What We’re Looking For On Your Resume A validated top performer with a proven track record of breakthrough sales results. 5–10+ years of direct enterprise SaaS sales experience, preferably targeting Banking, Financial Services, Insurance (BFSI), or Fintech sectors. Bachelor’s degree or higher required. Demonstrated mastery of the MEDDPICC / MEDDIC sales process. Strong proficiency in Salesforce.com and sales forecasting hygiene. Experience developing complex business cases and ROI models focused on account retention, digital adoption, risk mitigation, and client lifetime value. Proven track record of navigating long, complex contract negotiations with highly regulated financial enterprises. Ability to travel up to 50% as needed for key client meetings, executive briefings, and industry summits. What You Should Know About This Team Dedicated to Financial Sector Demand: Meeting surging demand from enterprise financial leaders who are modernizing their institutions to transform client, policyholder, and employee engagement. Strategic & Collaborative Team: Goal-oriented, high-energy group that collaborates closely to navigate complex security and procurement cycles to win market leadership. Focused on Growth & Trust: Driven by an overarching objective to generate exponential revenue growth by empowering financial leaders to deliver exceptional, trust-building experiences across every channel. Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits Competitive Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions and Performance Accelerators. Merit-Based Growth: 100% performance-based promotions—driven by results, not politics or tenure. Culture: A vibrant, inclusive work environment—wear jeans and bring your dog to the office anytime. Team & Swag: Quarterly team outings, winter and summer parties, and exclusive team swag. Health & Wellness: Comprehensive private health insurance, wellness stipend, and rich mental/physical health benefits. Qualtrics Experience Bonus: An annual cash bonus designed specifically for you to fund a personal dream experience—whether that’s a dream vacation, attending a major event, or personal passion projects.
